name: Oliwier Mako
role: Website designer, front-end developer, and digital product builder
summary: Oliwier designs and builds thoughtful, responsive websites and digital products with clear structure, deliberate interaction, and technical detail that holds up after launch.

services.focus: Custom website direction, design, development, and responsive polish.
services.projectFit: A good conversation starts with what the website needs to explain, who it needs to help, what already exists, and what a successful launch should change.
services.idealClients: Oliwier would especially like to work with people who value their own time and their customers' time, and who want either a strong new website or a more effective, higher-converting version of what they already have. The result should look excellent, feel excellent, and make the next action clear.

process.description: Clarify the goal, audience, content, constraints, and strongest idea for the site.
Turn the structure into a distinctive visual and interaction system.
Build the responsive front end and preserve the design intent in code.
Test layout, accessibility, interactions, performance, and edge cases before launch.

selectedWork.name: Zarvalo
selectedWork.status: A historical product direction preserved as an interactive browser-only portfolio demo.
selectedWork.audience: Local SEO agencies researching local businesses and preparing relevant outreach.
selectedWork.problem: Prospecting often fragments discovery, qualification, notes, and message preparation across maps, spreadsheets, and generic outreach tools.
workflow: Choose a business niche and location to research.
Discover local businesses from a Google Maps-style search workflow.
Review website, contact, review, ranking, and local SEO opportunity signals.
Score and prioritize businesses by visible opportunity and commercial fit.
Keep leads, evidence, status, notes, and outreach context together.
Prepare a specific outreach angle and export a focused shortlist.
selectedWork.whatItShows: Product thinking, information architecture, data-heavy interface design, responsive front-end development, multi-step workflow design, filtering, state management, and explaining complex evidence clearly.
selectedWork.demoDisclosure: The public demo uses deterministic synthetic data stored only in the browser. It does not perform live scraping, send outreach, require a login, or use a production database.

selectedWork.name: Northline Cycle Works
selectedWork.summary: A five-page bicycle restoration website concept built to demonstrate art direction, product storytelling, responsive design, filtering, and multi-page consistency.
selectedWork.disclosure: Northline is a fictional, self-initiated concept rather than a client business.

selectedWork.name: Ask Oliwier
selectedWork.summary: A live AI interface grounded only in Oliwier's committed public portfolio profile, with streamed answers and a deliberately safe formatter.

about: Oliwier started with websites to understand how the internet works. He now cares about the full process: the idea, the interface, the code, and whether the result is genuinely useful.

education.currentStatus: Oliwier currently studies at Polhemskolan in Lund, Sweden.
education.programme: Teknikprogrammet, the Swedish upper-secondary technical programme
education.context: Oliwier describes Polhemskolan as a highly regarded Swedish gymnasium. His studies strengthen the technical and problem-solving side of his work.

interests: Learning new things that may look unrelated at first but often connect later
personal.perspective: He is curious across subjects and likes finding useful connections between design, technology, business, psychology, and everyday life.

designApproach.principle: Oliwier studies real design patterns that are already proven to communicate and convert, then adapts those principles into a distinctive site instead of reaching for a basic template.
priorities: A strong visual idea rather than decoration everywhere
Interaction that feels deliberate and supports the message
Responsive implementation that preserves the design intent
A useful path toward inquiry or another meaningful action
designApproach.example: His own portfolio is an example of this approach: a restrained Precision Grid system, oversized editorial typography, generous white space, purposeful motion, and real interactive work.

proofOfCapability: The portfolio itself, Zarvalo, Northline Cycle Works, Ask Oliwier, and The Quiet Advantage are the clearest public evidence of what Oliwier can design, build, structure, and finish. They should be discussed as proof of range, not as client testimonials or guaranteed business outcomes.

book.title: The Quiet Advantage
book.format: A personal collection of lessons and working ideas rather than a definitive guide.
book.summary: An early book about thinking more clearly, getting useful work done, and keeping independent judgment while learning from other people and tools.
themes: Mindset, questioning assumptions, gratitude, and personal belief
Productivity, attention, energy, goals, momentum, and tracking your life
Learning many skills and connecting ideas across subjects
Money, intentional buying, generosity, earning, and using AI as a thinking partner
Psychology, privacy, simplicity, self-awareness, ethical persuasion, and action
Exercise, self-respect, and building practical, lasting skills
book.readingNote: The introduction asks readers to keep their own judgment, test ideas for themselves, and keep only what genuinely helps.

portfolio.purpose: The portfolio introduces Oliwier as a person, explains the website work he wants to do, and lets visitors judge the quality through the site and projects themselves.

contact.guidance: For a website inquiry, share what you are building, who it is for, what currently exists, and the outcome you want.
